domain_description: Comprehensive chemistry knowledge spanning organic, inorganic, physical, analytical, biochemistry, polymer, environmental, safety, process, catalysis, electrochemistry, nuclear, geochemistry, food, pharmaceutical, materials, chemical engineering, computational, green, and forensic chemistry. Based on IUPAC nomenclature, ACS guidelines, GHS hazard communication, EPA TSCA regulations, EU REACH, and ICH pharmaceutical guidelines.
authority_sources: GHS (Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling)
EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals)
NFPA 704 (Standard System for Identification of Hazards of Materials)
ASTM International Standards for Chemical Analysis

engines.name: Organic Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze organic reaction mechanisms, retrosynthetic analysis, stereochemistry, functional group transformations, named reactions, and total synthesis planning using IUPAC nomenclature and mechanistic frameworks.
doctrine_topics: named reactions and modern coupling reactions

golden_queries.question: Design a retrosynthetic analysis for ibuprofen starting from commercially available materials, identifying key disconnections and evaluating at least two synthetic routes

engines.name: Inorganic Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze inorganic compounds, coordination chemistry, crystal field theory, bioinorganic systems, solid-state materials, and main group chemistry using ligand field theory and group theory.
doctrine_topics: crystal field theory and ligand field splitting
main group element chemistry and periodicity

golden_queries.question: Predict the electronic structure, magnetic properties, and UV-Vis spectrum of [Cr(NH3)6]3+ using crystal field theory and compare with [Cr(H2O)6]3+

engines.name: Physical Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze thermodynamics, chemical kinetics, quantum chemistry, statistical mechanics, and surface chemistry using fundamental physical chemistry principles and mathematical frameworks.
doctrine_topics: chemical thermodynamics Gibbs energy and equilibrium
chemical kinetics rate laws and mechanisms
quantum chemistry particle-in-a-box to molecular orbitals
chemical equilibrium and Le Chatelier principle

golden_queries.question: For the reaction N2O4(g) = 2NO2(g), calculate Kp at 25C and 100C given standard thermodynamic data, and predict the effect of pressure and temperature on equilibrium composition
required_elements: delta-G calculation from delta-H and delta-S

engines.name: Analytical Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze quantitative and qualitative analytical methods including chromatography, spectroscopy, electroanalytical techniques, method validation, and quality assurance per ASTM and USP standards.

golden_queries.question: Develop an HPLC method for simultaneous determination of acetaminophen and caffeine in a tablet formulation, including column selection, mobile phase optimization, and ICH Q2 validation parameters

engines.name: Biochemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze biomolecular structure, enzyme kinetics, metabolic pathways, protein folding, nucleic acid chemistry, and signal transduction using biochemical principles and molecular biology frameworks.

golden_queries.question: An enzyme shows Km of 50 uM and Vmax of 200 nmol/min. In the presence of inhibitor X (10 uM), apparent Km increases to 150 uM while Vmax remains unchanged. Classify the inhibition and calculate Ki.

engines.name: Polymer Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze polymer synthesis, characterization, structure-property relationships, polymerization mechanisms, processing techniques, and degradation per ASTM polymer testing standards.

golden_queries.question: Design an ATRP synthesis of a well-defined block copolymer of polystyrene-b-poly(methyl methacrylate) with target Mn of 50,000 g/mol and PDI less than 1.2

engines.name: Environmental Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze environmental contaminant fate and transport, water and air quality chemistry, remediation technologies, environmental monitoring, and regulatory compliance per EPA methods and standards.
doctrine_topics: climate chemistry greenhouse gases and radiative forcing

golden_queries.question: A groundwater monitoring well shows benzene at 50 ppb, MTBE at 200 ppb, and dissolved oxygen at 0.5 mg/L. Characterize the contamination source, predict plume behavior, and recommend remediation approach.

engines.name: Chemical Safety Engine
engines.function: Analyze chemical hazards, safety data sheets, exposure limits, emergency response, laboratory safety, and process safety management per GHS, OSHA HCS, and NFPA standards.

golden_queries.question: A laboratory worker is found to have been exposed to hydrofluoric acid vapor above the TLV for 4 hours. The concentration measured was 5 ppm. Outline the complete response protocol and medical surveillance requirements.

engines.name: Process Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze chemical process scale-up, reaction optimization, process intensification, continuous flow chemistry, and manufacturing process development from lab to production scale.
doctrine_topics: heat and mass transfer in chemical processes
quality by design QbD in process development

golden_queries.question: Scale up an exothermic Grignard reaction from 1L laboratory to 1000L pilot plant scale. The laboratory run shows an adiabatic temperature rise of 85C. Address safety, mixing, and heat transfer challenges.

engines.name: Catalysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis, catalyst design, reaction mechanism elucidation, catalyst deactivation, and industrial catalytic processes using transition state theory and microkinetics.

golden_queries.question: A heterogeneous Pd/C catalyst for hydrogenation of nitrobenzene shows 50% activity loss after 100 hours. Diagnose potential deactivation mechanisms and propose regeneration or replacement strategies.

engines.name: Electrochemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze electrochemical systems including batteries, fuel cells, corrosion, electroplating, electrolysis, and electroanalytical methods using Nernst equation and Butler-Volmer kinetics.

golden_queries.question: Design a lithium-ion battery cell for an EV application requiring 60 kWh capacity, analyzing cathode chemistry options (NMC 811 vs LFP vs NCA), including energy density, cycle life, and thermal stability tradeoffs
required_elements: specific energy and energy density calculations

engines.name: Nuclear Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze radioactive decay kinetics, nuclear reactions, radiation detection, radiochemical separations, nuclear fuel cycle, and radiation safety per NRC regulations and ICRP recommendations.
doctrine_topics: radioactive decay kinetics and half-life calculations
nuclear fuel cycle enrichment to waste

golden_queries.question: Calculate the activity of a Cs-137 source (t1/2 = 30.17 years) that was 500 mCi on January 1, 2000. Determine the current activity, dose rate at 1 meter, and required shielding to reduce exposure below 2 mrem/hr.
required_elements: dose rate using specific gamma constant

engines.name: Geochemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze geochemical processes including mineral equilibria, aqueous geochemistry, isotope geochemistry, petroleum geochemistry, and weathering reactions in natural systems.

golden_queries.question: Interpret a produced water analysis from a Permian Basin well showing Na 45,000 ppm, Ca 12,000 ppm, Cl 98,000 ppm, SO4 50 ppm, Ba 280 ppm, Sr 1,200 ppm, with delta-18O of +2 permil and delta-D of -15 permil. Determine water origin and scaling potential.
required_elements: isotope plot interpretation meteoric vs connate

engines.name: Food Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze food composition, food additives, Maillard reactions, lipid oxidation, food preservation chemistry, and nutritional biochemistry per FDA 21 CFR and Codex Alimentarius standards.
doctrine_topics: food additive safety and GRAS determination
food color chemistry natural and synthetic

golden_queries.question: A food manufacturer is experiencing rapid rancidity in a nut-based snack bar with 6 months target shelf life. The product contains 18% fat, iron-fortified, and stored at ambient temperature. Analyze the oxidation mechanisms and recommend stabilization strategies.

engines.name: Pharmaceutical Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze drug design, SAR analysis, formulation development, stability testing, impurity profiling, and regulatory chemistry requirements per ICH guidelines and FDA regulations.
doctrine_topics: impurity identification and qualification ICH Q3
analytical method development for drug substances

golden_queries.question: An oral tablet formulation shows a new impurity at 0.15% after 6 months accelerated stability (40C/75% RH). The API has a daily dose of 200 mg. Determine the ICH qualification threshold and outline the impurity investigation strategy.
required_elements: ICH Q3B threshold calculation for 200 mg dose

engines.name: Materials Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze advanced materials including semiconductors, ceramics, composites, nanomaterials, thin films, and functional materials using solid-state chemistry and materials characterization techniques.

golden_queries.question: Design a metal oxide semiconductor thin film for a transparent conducting electrode application. Compare ITO, AZO, and FTO options including deposition methods, conductivity, transparency, and cost.

engines.name: Chemical Engineering Engine
engines.function: Analyze chemical process design, unit operations, reactor engineering, separation processes, heat transfer, and plant design per Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook and ASME standards.
doctrine_topics: heat exchanger design and LMTD method

golden_queries.question: Design a continuous distillation column to separate a binary mixture of methanol and water (feed 40 mol% methanol) producing 95 mol% distillate and 5 mol% bottoms at 1000 kmol/hr feed rate. Determine minimum reflux, actual stages, and column diameter.

engines.name: Computational Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze molecular modeling approaches including DFT, molecular dynamics, Monte Carlo methods, docking simulations, and QSAR modeling using established computational chemistry frameworks.
doctrine_topics: density functional theory DFT methods and basis sets
molecular dynamics simulation setup and analysis
Monte Carlo methods in chemical systems
ab initio methods Hartree-Fock and post-HF

golden_queries.question: Select the appropriate level of theory (method and basis set) to calculate the activation energy for a Diels-Alder reaction between cyclopentadiene and maleic anhydride, justifying the choice and estimating computational cost.

engines.name: Green Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze sustainable chemistry approaches including the 12 principles of green chemistry, atom economy, solvent substitution, waste minimization, renewable feedstocks, and life cycle assessment.
doctrine_topics: twelve principles of green chemistry Anastas
atom economy and reaction mass efficiency
life cycle assessment LCA for chemicals

golden_queries.question: Compare the green chemistry metrics (atom economy, E-factor, PMI) for two synthetic routes to adipic acid: traditional cyclohexane oxidation with nitric acid versus direct bioconversion from glucose using engineered E. coli

engines.name: Forensic Chemistry Engine
engines.function: Analyze forensic evidence chemistry including drug analysis, fire debris analysis, explosives residue, toxicology, trace evidence, and quality assurance per SWGDRUG and ASTM forensic standards.
doctrine_topics: chain of custody and evidence handling

golden_queries.question: Fire debris samples collected from three locations in a warehouse show the presence of a medium petroleum distillate via GC-MS. Outline the complete analytical protocol per ASTM E1618, including sample preparation, data interpretation, and comparison to reference standards.
